sections.content: SQL string functions transform text: UPPER/LOWER, LENGTH, SUBSTRING, TRIM, CONCAT, REPLACE, POSITION, and pattern matching with LIKE.
Functions differ per engine: PostgreSQL has || for concat and SPLIT_PART; MySQL uses CONCAT() and SUBSTRING_INDEX().
Key points: TRIM removes padding spaces, SUBSTRING is 1-indexed in most engines, LIKE is case-insensitive in MySQL but sensitive in Postgres (use ILIKE), and regex via ~ (Postgres) or REGEXP (MySQL).

sections.codeExample:
SELECT UPPER(name), SUBSTRING(email, 1, 3) AS prefix
FROM users;
